group_note: All six were read as the same printed shape - one question, four bare answers, no lettered block or list - and were kept consistent by three stated rules. (1) DEMAND: every member is `recall`, because in each one a single stored fact (a dental formula, a wall type, a term, a cell count, a tissue identity) decides the answer and nothing is applied to a new case; no member was given `concept_discrimination`, because in none of them is the decision between two neighbouring concepts rather than between a known and an unknown fact. (2) STRUCTURE: every member is `single_step`. q065 looks like four checks but is not: one fact - that the milk set has no premolars - settles it, and the other three options are not independently verified so much as left standing. (3) TRAPS: tagged only where the specific fact that makes the option wrong can be named. q065 is the one negated member, so its three distractors carry `true_statement_trap` with the polarity quoted; the recall members carry `other_one_fact` wherever the distractor is the correct fact about a different member of the same family, with the member named each time (q067's three protist groups, q070's two seed tissues, q068's template). Two labels are used once each because nothing else fits as tightly: `look_alike_term` for q068's "Carrier", a plain-English synonym of the technical term, and `fabricated_term` for "Transformer", which names no molecule in the vocabulary. q069 is the member that differs most and the reason is its option set, which is built from counts rather than from names: its three distractors are a miscount (`calculation_slip`), the earlier two-celled stage of the same structure (`intermediate_value`) and an arrangement no division sequence produces (`no_derivation_route`). One member is not tagged on the trap axis at all: 2015_A#q066 arrived damaged - its keyed option reads "Without division" while option 4 reads "Undergoing division", two contradictory wordings of one axis, so the property that defines a protoplast is not present in the stored option set - and it therefore carries source_damage_artifact with empty traps. Options with no nameable route (q070 option 2) are left untagged and said to be so in the note rather than given a nearest label. No trap sits on any official answer.
